components.css: .ds-answers{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;min-width:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302c26)}.ds-answers legend{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#686254);margin-bottom:10px}.ds-answer-grid{display:grid;gap:8px;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}.ds-answer-grid label{position:relative;min-width:0}.ds-answer-grid input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-answer-grid span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;min-height:54px;padding:8px 4px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--answer-border,#bfb9a9);border-radius:7px;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}.ds-answer-grid small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#686254)}.ds-answer-grid label:hover span{border-color:var(--green,#3e5949);background:#f0f2e9}.ds-answer-grid input:checked+span{border-color:var(--green,#3e5949);background:var(--sage,#e4eadd);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green,#3e5949)}.ds-answer-grid input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8492b);outline-offset:3px}.ds-answer-grid .ds-correct span{background:var(--green,#3e5949);border-color:var(--green,#3e5949);color:var(--inverse,#fffdf4)}.ds-answer-grid .ds-correct small{color:#e5ecdf}.ds-answer-grid .ds-incorrect span{background:var(--answer-error-bg,#f3e2d9);border-color:var(--error,#963e29);color:var(--error,#963e29)}.ds-answer-grid .ds-incorrect small{color:inherit}.ds-answer-grid input:disabled+span{cursor:default}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-answer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.ds-answer-grid span{min-height:52px;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;font-size:17px}.ds-answer-grid small{font-size:10px}}

components.css: .ds-settings{border-block:1px solid var(--line,#d7d2c4);margin-bottom:24px;font:13px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#686254)}.ds-settings>summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:52px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-settings summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-settings summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8492b);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-settings-change{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--ink,#302c26);flex-shrink:0}.ds-settings-change svg{transition:transform .15s}.ds-settings[open] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}.ds-settings p{font-size:12px;padding:8px 0 20px;margin:0}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-settings{margin-bottom:20px}.ds-settings>summary{font-size:12px;min-height:48px;gap:8px}.ds-settings-change{font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-settings-change svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A compact practice desk combines warm paper, dark ink, terracotta actions and sage learning states. Georgia gives headings and musical symbols a human, familiar voice; Arial keeps instructions and controls direct. The interface is quiet and compact, with ruled divisions and one plain practice surface.

The same heading, closed settings summary and restrained controls recur across the four exercises. The circle diagram and metronome retain their teaching roles; ornamental screws and inset equipment framing do not return. The visual system supports quick practice with a guitar in hand.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and dark ink with restrained terracotta and sage.
Compact headings, readable musical symbols and touch-sized controls.
Flat practice surfaces with quiet borders.
Stable answer controls, explicit settings application and optional explanations.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use terracotta for emphasis and focus, green for key context and correct answers, and error color for incorrect answers. Dark ink carries the primary button.

rules.name: The Anchored Answer Rule
rules.body: Keep the answer grid in place after submission; change its state and reveal feedback below it. The primary action changes to continue in the same action row.

rules.name: The Flat Practice Rule
rules.body: Keep practice surfaces flat. Reserve ambient shadow for the modal reference; use the small inset stroke only to reinforce answer selection.

dos: Do reuse the paper, surface, ink and state colors from the frontmatter.
Do pair Georgia headings and musical symbols with Arial instructions and controls.
Do retain the answer grid and show concise feedback in place.
Do keep settings collapsed initially, apply drafts explicitly and restore drafts on cancel or closure.
Do place theory in native disclosures and keep visible keyboard focus.
Do skip the question entrance and CSS transitions when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't restore screw ornaments, simulated hardware or inset equipment frames.
Don't stretch trainer controls to the full desktop shell.
Don't use correct/error color as the only feedback; retain the written answer and explanation.
Don't silently reset an active round when a draft preference changes.
Don't introduce decorative imagery into the practice controls.
